title: YouTubeRelayStaticRecoveryResolveRequest
description: Explicit operator attestation used only when a live_api_relay_static broadcast insert outcome is unknown. It cannot carry an external URL, provider error, credential, or stream key.

confirm_external_cleanup.description: Must be true only after the operator has confirmed that any externally-created unstarted broadcast was deleted. A known provider broadcast is deleted by Control Panel instead.
